bds.h: Judge blasts DOJ in dismissing case against ex-FBI agents who probed Hunter Biden
bds.lede: A judge has dismissed the DOJ's federal false statements case against two former FBI agents accused of lying to Congress about past investigations of Hunter Biden.
rows: A judge has dismissed the DOJ's federal false statements case against two former FBI agents accused of lying to Congress about past investigations of Hunter Biden.
A federal judge tossed charges accusing two former FBI officials of lying to Congress about Hunter Biden investigation.
The two former FBI officials, Nicole Floris and Bradley Benavides, were accused of falsely suggesting to Congress that they weren't aware of the federal investigations surrounding Hunter Biden.
The two FBI agents were charged with making false statements to Congress while testifying about the bureau’s role in investigating Biden’s laptop
The Justice Department may still have an opportunity to pursue a grand jury indictment against the ex-FBI officials.
Magistrate Judge Zia Faruqui said the case against Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides failed to establish probable cause for the charges against them.
